title: White-paper restart: directly routable paid value flows
objective: Find current two-sided value flows where one side has underused time/skill/capacity and the other side already pays for a bounded result; prefer flows that can be manually routed and settled before any platform, qualification system or institutional rail is built.
governing_logic: REAL PAIN_OR_UNUSED_CAPACITY + CURRENT_PAID_OUTCOME + BOUNDED_TASK + ACCEPTANCE + SETTLEMENT

observed.fact: China's 2026 youth-employment policy explicitly supports flexible employment for graduates in digital, creative and platform-economy work.

Current job markets show students and young workers accepting task-based, remote, content, data and other flexible work; this is used only as evidence of available/aspiring flexible capacity, not proof of any one candidate's supply sufficiency.

candidate_flows.name: Local commercial content micro-orders
candidate_flows.simple_description: A local merchant/manufacturer buys one concrete video/photo/content deliverable; a young creator/student/freelancer produces it; the operator defines the brief, selects the creator, checks acceptance and settles the unit.
candidate_flows.side_a_underused_capacity: Young creators/students/freelancers with phone/camera/editing ability, available time and desire for paid portfolio/income.
candidate_flows.side_b_current_paid_need: Small businesses and manufacturers need product videos, short-form content, photography and edits but do not always need or want a full-time employee/agency retainer.

current_transaction_evidence.fact: A current Jiangsu machinery company explicitly recruits a part-time video creator with remote production, per-shoot/per-video settlement, buyer confirmation as acceptance, and 1-2 revision rounds.
Current Jiangsu part-time content work shows per-video settlement and flexible student/worker participation.
Current Xuzhou listings show businesses using part-time/short-form content labor and product-promotion roles, confirming local task demand exists.

bounded_unit_examples: one product video from brief to accepted final cut
one on-site product/photo shoot with defined shot list
one batch of 5-10 platform-ready clips from provided material
candidate_flows.acceptance_shape: Buyer-approved final media against brief, format, deadline and revision limit.
candidate_flows.money_path: buyer pays per unit -> creator receives delivery fee -> operator retains explicit coordination/acceptance margin
contradictions: Freelance/content platforms and local agencies already exist.
Very simple editing is commoditized and low-margin.
If buyer and creator repeat directly after the first order, the operator may be bypassed unless it owns ongoing task intake, quality assurance or replacement.
candidate_flows.first_test: Find one current local business with a single bounded content task and one creator willing to quote it; compare buyer budget, creator price, acceptance requirements and operator margin before any platform build.

candidate_flows.name: SME AI / office-workflow micro-project routing
candidate_flows.simple_description: A small enterprise has one concrete workflow/data/AI task; an AI-literate young operator/freelancer implements the bounded result; the connector scopes, matches, verifies and settles.
candidate_flows.side_a_underused_capacity: Young people who can use ChatGPT/Codex/Claude, Excel/PowerBI, Dify/n8n/RPA and light development but lack a steady flow of real business projects.
candidate_flows.side_b_current_paid_need: SMEs that want practical AI/data/workflow results but lack in-house AI staff.

current_transaction_evidence.fact: A 2026 government survey in Changzhou found 41% of surveyed enterprises report lack of AI management/R&D/operations talent; 72% have no dedicated AI talent and rely on external cooperation, while 41% report no current cooperation but an intention to cooperate.

A current Jiangsu company advertises a flexible/part-time AI application role focused on AI-enabling existing web systems, workflow automation, enterprise data cleanup and knowledge-base construction.

A current project-based AI service team advertises enterprise AI/automation projects as bounded work units delivered by part-time developers and settled by project milestones, which proves projectization is feasible but also proves incumbents exist.

bounded_unit_examples: build one internal FAQ/knowledge-base assistant from a defined document set
clean and structure one bounded historical data set
candidate_flows.acceptance_shape: Defined workflow works on buyer-provided sample cases and passes agreed output checks.
candidate_flows.money_path: enterprise pays per micro-project -> external implementer receives project fee -> operator retains scope/matching/QA margin
contradictions: AI implementation agencies and freelance platforms already exist.
Technical scope can expand and create warranty/support burden.
The operator edge is weak if every project requires bespoke technical consulting by the founder.
candidate_flows.first_test: Use one small buyer workflow with a 1-3 day acceptance boundary; do not sell a transformation program.

candidate_flows.name: Local-presence field microtasks
candidate_flows.simple_description: A remote company needs a trusted person physically present in another city/country for a short checklist-driven task; a local student/young worker executes the visit; the operator matches, briefs, verifies evidence and settles.
candidate_flows.side_a_underused_capacity: Local students/young residents with time, smartphone, language/local knowledge and willingness to do short paid field tasks.
candidate_flows.side_b_current_paid_need: Remote/foreign companies that need an exhibition visit, store check, supplier/site verification, photos, information collection or other physical presence without sending their own employee.

current_transaction_evidence.fact: On 2026-09-10 a Polish building-materials company publicly sought one English-capable Chinese student/part-timer for a one-day Shanghai exhibition market-research task, with a clear checklist and about RMB 700-800 compensation.
Current Xuzhou listings show banks/service firms paying local part-timers for on-site business verification and photo evidence, proving physical verification can be atomized into paid local tasks.

A current global-local execution provider sells market visits, store visits, photo/video records, exhibition execution and other local-person tasks, proving the category exists and providing incumbent counterevidence.

bounded_unit_examples: one exhibition-day research checklist with photos, contacts and summary
one store/site visit with timestamped photo/video evidence
one local appointment or information-collection visit
candidate_flows.acceptance_shape: Checklist completion plus required evidence packet delivered by deadline.
candidate_flows.money_path: remote buyer pays task price -> local executor receives task fee -> operator retains sourcing/briefing/verification/replacement margin
contradictions: Local research/inspection/BPO firms and global freelancer platforms already exist.
Safety, privacy, trespass, debt collection and regulated inspection tasks must be excluded.
One-off tasks may not repeat unless the operator finds a recurring buyer segment such as exhibitions, distributed retail checks or cross-border supplier verification.
candidate_flows.first_test: Capture one legitimate checklist-based field task from a remote buyer and source one local executor; exclude debt collection, covert surveillance, regulated inspections and unsafe visits.

rejected_on_clean_slate.reason: violates clean-slate money-first logic unless the qualification is inherently required to deliver the paid outcome
money depends on institutional process rather than immediate counterparty value
two-sided platform construction is not required to prove one value flow
unclear bounded deliverable/acceptance encourages founder labor and long sales cycles

next_action: Validate the three fresh flows only at transaction-unit level. For each, find one current buyer-side task with a concrete budget/acceptance boundary and one independent provider quote/availability signal. Kill any flow that cannot produce a simple buyer-task-provider-margin equation without building infrastructure first.
